summary: Firefox expanded gtest coverage for media behavior that affects playback and video calls, including Android encoder size limits, A/V synchronization after seeking and resuming, and RGB-to-YUV conversion across color matrices and ranges. Tests also cover NV12 and I420 conversion compatibility, chroma preservation while downscaling, HEVC CRA/BLA keyframes in Matroska, and safer WebRTC GMP encoder shutdown.
